description: IO.puts(Integer.to_string(byte_size(String.duplicate("x", 100000)))) prints 'fatal runtime error: stack overflow, aborting' on run and exits 139 on build; interp prints 100000. Present on develop f822f0f84 as well as on the fz-sc8.183 stack. 50,000 works. Elixir has no such limit. Not yet investigated: whether String.duplicate recurses non-tail in lib, or whether any deep non-tail recursion overflows. Repro: scratchpad/lit/crash2.fz.
title: String.duplicate/2 of 100,000 overflows the native stack on run and build
